prompt: Stage 2-3, level 4, 11 gold. You own two copies of a 1-cost tank: one on the board, one on the bench. The shop shows a third copy for 1 gold, a 3-cost ranged carry for 3 and a 2-cost caster for 2. What do you buy?

options.label: The third tank copy: 1 gold turns your two 1-stars into a 2-star
The 3-cost carry: it is the strongest unit in the shop
Refresh for 2 gold and look for something better
Nothing: hold the 11 gold toward interest

explanation:
Three copies merge into a 2-star the moment you buy the third, and a 2-star 1-cost has far more health and damage than the single copy it replaces. For 1 gold, that is the best buy in the game. The 3-cost carry looks stronger, but a 1-star 3-cost is not better than a 2-star 1-cost this early, costs three times as much, and belongs to no plan yet.

Refreshing throws away a shop that already has what you need. Holding is right when the shop is empty; this shop is not.
principle: A copy of a champion you own is the first thing to look for in every shop.
commonMistake: Buying the most expensive unit in the shop instead of the 1-gold copy that makes a 2-star.
hint: Compare each shop slot with what is already on your board and bench before you look at prices.
